items.title: Omdia: OWS Shipments Grow 12% as TWS Market Remains Broadly Flat in 2Q26
items.summary: Global true wireless stereo (TWS) shipments fell 0.7% year-over-year to 82.1 million units in Q2 2026, the first annual decline since 2Q23, while open wireless stereo (OWS) grew 12% to 11.1 million units, lifting its share of the category to 13.5%.

items.title: Bose Doubles Down on Open-Ear Audio With Ultra Open 2nd Gen and Sport Open Earbuds
items.summary: Bose refreshed its open-ear lineup with the Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) at $299, adding a new driver for deeper bass, Cinema Mode with TrueSpatial, and wireless charging, plus a $199 Sport variant, both available October 1 after September 19 preorders.

items.title: Noise and Bose Team Up on Affordable, Futuristic Open-Ear Earbuds
items.summary: Indian brand Noise unveiled its first open-ear earbuds, the Master Buds Open, at IFA Berlin 2026, built with Sound by Bose tuning and a clip-on design, priced around EUR 119 and planned to launch in late September 2026.

items.title: Sonova Announces Sennheiser Momentum True Wireless 5 Earbuds
items.summary: Sennheiser's Momentum True Wireless 5 ships September 3, 2026 at $299.95, featuring Bluetooth 6, Snapdragon Sound, user-replaceable batteries, 12 hours of playback per charge, and a selectable robust RF mode for crowded environments.

items.title: Realme Buds T500 Pro With Harry Potter Sigil Debut In India at Rs 6,999
items.summary: Realme launched the Buds T500 Pro Harry Potter Edition TWS earbuds in India on September 21 alongside the Realme 16 Pro 5G, with 12.4mm drivers, 50dB ANC, Bluetooth 6.1, Hi-Res audio, and 56 hours total playback, sales starting September 22.

items.title: HIFIMAN Puts an R-2R Ladder DAC Inside $299 Wireless Earbuds
items.summary: HIFIMAN announced the Svanar Wireless 2 on September 2, 2026, a $299 pair of true wireless earbuds housing its proprietary HYMALAYA Mini R-2R DAC chip, with Bluetooth 6.0, LDAC and L2HC support, and ANC rated to -35dB.

items.title: Sony WF-1000XM6 Review: Sound Great, ANC Falls Short
items.summary: Sony's $329.99 flagship WF-1000XM6 earns praise for detailed, customizable sound and strong isolation, but independent testing finds its noise cancellation trails the Bose QuietComfort Ultra 2 and AirPods Pro 3, with fit requiring patience.

items.title: Oppo Enco X4 Colourways and Key Features Revealed Ahead of September 22 Launch
items.summary: Oppo teased the Enco X4 TWS earbuds ahead of their September 22 global launch, highlighting a 6nm chip, fourth-generation Dynaudio co-developed coaxial dual drivers, lossless transmission up to 400% faster, and AI-powered real-time two-way translation.

items.title: CMF's First Open-Ear Earbuds Arrive With a Smart Dial Charging Case
items.summary: Nothing's CMF sub-brand launched the Clip Pro, its first open-ear earbuds, at $99, featuring a three-point titanium-wire clip, 10.8mm drivers, Ultra Bass Technology, a rotating Smart Dial on the case, and a global rollout completed by September 15, 2026.

items.title: BoAt Airdopes Prime 800D Launched With Google Gemini-Powered AI, Dolby Audio and 45-Hour Battery
items.summary: BoAt's Airdopes Prime 800D brings Google Gemini-powered Crest AI to budget earbuds at Rs 1,999, with 11mm drivers, Dolby Audio, four-microphone ENC, live two-way translation across 25 languages, and up to 45 hours of total battery life.
